name: Love & Dehumanization
source:
This is an adult visual novel that takes place in a fantasy RPG world. A girl willingly becomes a monster and is subject to brutal violence. Though she doesn't realize it, hope is somehow waiting on the other side of this cruelty.

At its core, this story is about the desire to be violated and dehumanized, to be viewed as lesser, to be stripped of your autonomy. It is a story about how this desire manifests and inflicts itself, how it hurts and traumatizes us, and how to reclaim it in the name of catharsis and love.

[From [url=https://aria-of-flowers.itch.io/love-and-dehumanization]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
這是一部發生在奇幻RPG世界的成人視覺小說。一個女孩自願成為怪物，遭受殘酷的暴力。儘管她沒有察覺，希望，仍以某種方式，在這份殘忍的另一端等待。

故事的核心，是渴望遭受侵犯、被剝奪人格、被視為低人一等、被奪去自主權的慾望。它講述這種慾望如何顯現、如何施加於自身，如何傷害我們、留下創傷，又如何以宣洩與愛之名，重新將其掌握。

[摘自[url=https://aria-of-flowers.itch.io/love-and-dehumanization]itch.io[/url]]
